question: What condition afflicts even the wise at the source of nectar?
premises: The location is the tip of nectar
There is burning by the essence of juice
Even a wise person is affected
inference: Even the wise may experience burning at the source of nectar.
uncertainties: The physiological referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are esoteric.
plain_english: Even the wise one is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
